Signalweave Protocol golden fixture: tool_call_completed_v1.swp

Additive fixture (Milestone 5): proves a typed inference/tool-call control message
round-trips byte-for-byte, independent of the ReliableEvent fixture (reliable_event_v1.swp).

framing = size-prefixed FlatBuffers
file_identifier = SWP1
protocol_version = 1
message_kind = ToolCallCompleted (32)
delivery_class = ReliableOrdered (1)
namespace_id = 1
session_id = 1
space_id = 1
channel_id = none
entity_id = 7
space_epoch = 1
server_tick = 0
sender_sequence = 0
correlation_id = none
control_payload = ToolCallCompletedPayload { new_revision = 2, result = "status updated" }

Regenerate with: cargo run -p signalweave-protocol --example write_tool_call_completed_fixture
The Rust golden tests require byte-for-byte equality and equivalent decoded values.
